title: Hotpoint — Brand Guide
intro: Brand overview, customer profile, and selling angles for Hotpoint.

sections.title: Brand Story
sections.content: Tagline: "Good Honest Value." Value tier. Hotpoint is the entry-level brand from GE Appliances — basic white and black appliances for first-time buyers and rental properties. No frills, no smart features, just reliable appliances at the lowest GE price point. Hotpoint exists so GE can compete in the value segment without diluting the GE Appliances brand.

sections.title: The Right Customer
sections.content: Builder spec packages, rental properties, budget replacements where the cheapest reliable option is the right option.

sections.title: Selling Angles
sections.content:
Key selling angles for Hotpoint:

• GE-built quality at the absolute lowest price

• Simple and reliable — fewer features means fewer things that can break

• Available at every retailer — easy to buy, easy to get serviced

• Perfect builder-spec brand — meets code requirements at minimum cost

• Parts readily available through GE network
